package onboarding

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}
type IDGenerator interface{ NewID() string }
type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

type Service struct {
	Teachers                  TeacherEnsurer
	Dialogs                   repository.TeacherDialogProvisioner
	Sources                   repository.DialogAssistantUISourceReader
	StructuredMessages        repository.DialogTeacherStructuredProactiveAppender
	PlainMessages             repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender
	CanonicalMessages         repository.DialogCanonicalStudentTurnMaterializer
	Students                  repository.StudentOnboardingGateway
	Receipts                  repository.OnboardingActionReceiptStore
	Interactions              repository.TeacherOnboardingInteractionRegistry
	Readiness                 repository.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver
	Handoffs                  repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore
	PathOutcomes              repository.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeProjectionReader
	TerminalSessions          repository.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionStore
	IDs                       IDGenerator
	Clock                     Clock
	LeaseTTL                  time.Duration
	CanonicalActionsEnabled   bool
	UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled bool
	ProductAwareEnabled       bool
	PlannerHandoffEnabled     bool
	PathOutcomeEnabled        bool
}

func (service Service) Ensure(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	session, found, err := service.readHistoricalSession(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	if found {
		if session.V3 == nil || session.V3.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting || !service.fullCutoverAdmissionEnabled() {
			return session, nil
		}
	}
	if err := service.requireCanonicalEnsureAdmission(); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	teacher, binding, state, err := service.loadSession(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	session, ensureErr := service.ensureCanonicalV3(ctx, teacher, binding, state)
	if ensureErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, ensureErr
	}
	return service.attachDeliveredPathOutcome(ctx, teacher, session)
}

func (service Service) readHistoricalSession(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, bool, error) {
	if service.TerminalSessions != nil {
		terminal, found, err := service.TerminalSessions.FindOnlyRecoverableForStudent(ctx, studentID)
		if err != nil {
			if historicalEvidenceUnavailable(err) {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, err
			}
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, onboardingDependency(err)
		}
		if found {
			session, recoverErr := service.recoverActivePathTerminal(ctx, terminal)
			return session, recoverErr == nil, recoverErr
		}
	}
	reader, ok := service.Interactions.(repository.TeacherOnboardingSessionInteractionReader)
	if !ok || reader == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, nil
	}
	interaction, found, err := reader.FindRecoverableInteractionForStudent(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		if historicalEvidenceUnavailable(err) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, err
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	if found {
		if interaction.StudentID != studentID {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionHandoffPending {
			return service.readLinkedHandoffSession(ctx, studentID, interaction)
		}
		if interaction.State != domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive && interaction.State != domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		return collectingSessionFromInteraction(interaction)
	}

	handoffReader, handoffsReadable := service.Handoffs.(repository.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffReader)
	if handoffsReadable && handoffReader != nil {
		intent, handoffFound, handoffErr := handoffReader.FindOnlyRecoverableHandoffForStudent(ctx, studentID)
		if handoffErr != nil {
			if historicalEvidenceUnavailable(handoffErr) {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, handoffErr
			}
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, onboardingDependency(handoffErr)
		}
		if handoffFound {
			return service.historicalHandoffSession(ctx, intent)
		}
	}
	hasInteractionHistory, historyErr := reader.HasInteractionHistory(ctx, studentID)
	if historyErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, onboardingDependency(historyErr)
	}
	if hasInteractionHistory {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	if handoffsReadable && handoffReader != nil {
		hasHandoffHistory, handoffHistoryErr := handoffReader.HasHandoffHistory(ctx, studentID)
		if handoffHistoryErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, onboardingDependency(handoffHistoryErr)
		}
		if hasHandoffHistory {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
	}
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, nil
}

func (service Service) recoverActivePathTerminal(ctx context.Context, terminal domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	terminal, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingTerminalSession(terminal)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	if terminal.Status == domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending {
		if service.Students == nil || service.PlainMessages == nil || service.TerminalSessions == nil || service.Clock == nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		state, stateErr := service.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, terminal.StudentID)
		if stateErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(stateErr)
		}
		stateRef, stateErr := domain.TeacherReadinessStateRefFromOnboarding(state, terminal.StudentID)
		if stateErr != nil || stateRef != terminal.StateRef {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		binding, bindingErr := domain.NewTeacherDialogBinding(domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: terminal.DialogID, StudentID: terminal.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: terminal.PersonalTeacherID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral})
		if bindingErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		message, appendErr := service.PlainMessages.AppendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, terminal.TerminalMessageCommandID, domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeBody(domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), domain.TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists))
		if appendErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(appendErr)
		}
		if message.ID == "" || message.DialogID != terminal.DialogID || message.PersonalTeacherID != terminal.PersonalTeacherID {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		terminal, err = service.TerminalSessions.MarkDelivered(ctx, terminal.ID, message.ID, service.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
		}
	}
	return domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: terminal.DialogID,
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists, Phase: domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart,
		StateRef: terminal.StateRef, Terminal: &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists},
	})
}

func (service Service) readLinkedHandoffSession(ctx context.Context, studentID string, interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, bool, error) {
	if interaction.SessionSchemaVersion != 3 || interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID == "" {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	reader, ok := service.Handoffs.(repository.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffReader)
	if !ok || reader == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	intent, found, err := reader.GetBySourceSession(ctx, studentID, interaction.ID, interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID)
	if err != nil {
		if historicalEvidenceUnavailable(err) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	if !found || intent.SourceInteractionID != interaction.ID || intent.SourceTeacherJobID != interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	return service.historicalHandoffSession(ctx, intent)
}

func (service Service) historicalHandoffSession(ctx context.Context, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, bool, error) {
	intent, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	session, err := durableHandoffSession(intent.DialogID, intent)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	if service.PathOutcomes != nil {
		session, err = service.attachPersistedPathOutcome(ctx, domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: intent.PersonalTeacherID, StudentID: intent.StudentID}, session)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, err
		}
	}
	return session, true, nil
}

func collectingSessionFromInteraction(interaction domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, bool, error) {
	messageVersion := int(interaction.PromptMessageVersion)
	switch interaction.SessionSchemaVersion {
	case 1:
		messageID := interaction.PromptMessageID
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{
			Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionSchema, DialogID: interaction.DialogID, MessageID: &messageID, MessageVersion: &messageVersion,
			Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft, DraftVersion: interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion, ProfileVersion: interaction.ExpectedProfileVersion,
		}, true, nil
	case 2, 3:
	default:
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	phase, err := onboardingPhaseForSlot(interaction.SlotCode)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	stateRef := domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateNone, Version: 0}
	if interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion > 0 {
		stateRef = domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: interaction.ExpectedDraftVersion}
	}
	current := &domain.TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt{MessageID: interaction.PromptMessageID, MessageVersion: messageVersion}
	if interaction.SessionSchemaVersion == 3 {
		session, sessionErr := domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{
			Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: interaction.DialogID, Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting,
			Phase: phase, StateRef: stateRef, CurrentPrompt: current,
		})
		return session, sessionErr == nil, sessionErr
	}
	session, sessionErr := domain.ProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSession(domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Schema, DialogID: interaction.DialogID, Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting,
		Phase: phase, StateRef: stateRef, CurrentPrompt: current,
	})
	return session, sessionErr == nil, sessionErr
}

func (service Service) attachDeliveredPathOutcome(ctx context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, session domain.TeacherOnboardingSession) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	if !service.PathOutcomeEnabled || session.V3 == nil {
		return session, nil
	}
	return service.attachPersistedPathOutcome(ctx, teacher, session)
}

func (service Service) attachPersistedPathOutcome(ctx context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, session domain.TeacherOnboardingSession) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	if session.V3 == nil {
		return session, nil
	}
	if session.V3.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted && session.V3.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists {
		return session, nil
	}
	if service.PathOutcomes == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	marker, found, err := service.PathOutcomes.FindDeliveredForSession(ctx, teacher.StudentID, teacher.ID, session.V3.DialogID, session.V3.StateRef)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	if !found {
		return session, nil
	}
	payload := *session.V3
	payload.PathOutcome = &marker
	return domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(payload)
}

func (service Service) ensureCanonicalV3(ctx context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, state domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	if service.Readiness == nil || service.PlainMessages == nil || service.Interactions == nil || !service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	stateRef, err := domain.TeacherReadinessStateRefFromOnboarding(state, teacher.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	readiness, err := service.Readiness.ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx, teacher.StudentID, stateRef)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	plan, err := domain.BuildTeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan(readiness, state, teacher.StudentID, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	return service.ensureDurableHandoff(ctx, teacher, binding, state, readiness, plan)
}

func (service Service) ensureDurableHandoff(ctx context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, state domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, readiness domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, plan domain.TeacherProductAwareOnboardingPlan) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	if service.Handoffs == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	payload := domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: binding.ID, Phase: plan.Phase, StateRef: plan.StateRef,
	}
	if plan.Status == domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionCollecting {
		commandID, err := domain.CurrentOnboardingPromptCommandID(binding, state.Draft.Version, state.ProfileVersion, plan.Step, domain.TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyV2)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
		}
		message, err := service.StructuredMessages.AppendTeacherStructuredProactive(ctx, binding, commandID, plan.Body, plan.AssistantUI)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
		}
		if message.DialogID != binding.ID || message.PersonalTeacherID != teacher.ID || message.Version < 1 {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		if err := service.ensureS5Interaction(ctx, binding, message.ID, message.Version, message.AssistantUI, plan.Step, state, 3); err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
		}
		payload.Status = domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting
		payload.CurrentPrompt = &domain.TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt{MessageID: message.ID, MessageVersion: message.Version}
		return domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(payload)
	}
	if plan.Status == domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionActivePathExists {
		if service.TerminalSessions == nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		terminal, terminalErr := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingActivePathTerminalSession(teacher, binding, plan.StateRef, service.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if terminalErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, terminalErr
		}
		terminal, _, terminalErr = service.TerminalSessions.EnsurePending(ctx, terminal)
		if terminalErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependencyOrConflict(terminalErr)
		}
		return service.recoverActivePathTerminal(ctx, terminal)
	}
	if plan.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady || readiness.Goal == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	intent, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(teacher, binding, readiness, domain.OnboardingLocale(state.Draft), "", "", service.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	stored, found, err := service.Handoffs.GetByStudentState(ctx, teacher.StudentID, readiness.StateRef, *readiness.Goal)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	if found {
		if !sameEnsureHandoffIdentity(stored, intent) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
		return durableHandoffSession(binding.ID, stored)
	}
	stored, _, err = service.Handoffs.Enqueue(ctx, repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue{Intent: intent}, service.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy) {
		interaction, found, closeErr := service.Interactions.CloseActiveInteractionForTerminal(ctx, binding.ID, teacher.ID, domain.TeacherOnboardingClosedPlanningReady, service.Clock.Now().UTC())
		if closeErr != nil || !found {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(errors.Join(err, closeErr))
		}
		phase, phaseErr := onboardingPhaseForSlot(interaction.SlotCode)
		if phaseErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, phaseErr
		}
		payload.Status, payload.Phase = domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Collecting, phase
		payload.CurrentPrompt = &domain.TeacherOnboardingCurrentPrompt{MessageID: interaction.PromptMessageID, MessageVersion: int(interaction.PromptMessageVersion)}
		return domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(payload)
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict) {
		stored, found, readErr := service.Handoffs.GetByStudentState(ctx, teacher.StudentID, readiness.StateRef, *readiness.Goal)
		if readErr == nil && found && sameEnsureHandoffIdentity(stored, intent) {
			return durableHandoffSession(binding.ID, stored)
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(errors.Join(err, readErr))
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	return durableHandoffSession(binding.ID, stored)
}

func sameEnsureHandoffIdentity(stored, expected domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) bool {
	stored, storedErr := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(stored)
	expected, expectedErr := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(expected)
	return storedErr == nil && expectedErr == nil &&
		stored.ID == expected.ID && stored.StudentID == expected.StudentID && stored.PersonalTeacherID == expected.PersonalTeacherID && stored.DialogID == expected.DialogID &&
		stored.CommandID == expected.CommandID && stored.CommandTeacherJobID == expected.CommandTeacherJobID && stored.RequestHash == expected.RequestHash &&
		stored.StateRef == expected.StateRef && stored.Goal == expected.Goal && stored.Locale == expected.Locale && stored.NotificationCommandID == expected.NotificationCommandID
}

func durableHandoffSession(dialogID string, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	displayName, err := domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDisplayName(intent.Goal)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, err
	}
	payload := domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: dialogID, StateRef: intent.StateRef}
	switch intent.Status {
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffQueued, domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching:
		payload.Status, payload.Phase = domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffPending, domain.TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath
		payload.Terminal = &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: payload.Status, DisplayName: displayName, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated}
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffAcceptedStatus, domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffMessagePending, domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDelivered:
		if intent.PlannerHandoffID == "" {
			payload.Status, payload.Phase = domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists, domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart
			payload.Terminal = &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: payload.Status}
			break
		}
		payload.Status, payload.Phase = domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted, domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart
		payload.Terminal = &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: payload.Status, DisplayName: displayName, ExecutionStatus: domain.TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated}
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath:
		payload.Status, payload.Phase = domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists, domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart
		payload.Terminal = &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: payload.Status}
	default:
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	return domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(payload)
}

func (service Service) ensureS5Interaction(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, messageID string, messageVersion int, assistantUI []byte, step domain.TeacherOnboardingStep, state domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, sessionSchemaVersion int) error {
	if service.Interactions == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	interaction, err := domain.NewS5OnboardingInteractionFromPrompt(binding, messageID, messageVersion, assistantUI, step, state.Draft.Version, state.ProfileVersion, sessionSchemaVersion, service.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, _, err = service.Interactions.EnsureActiveInteraction(ctx, interaction)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict) {
		// A reserved interaction for the same prompt is an in-flight canonical
		// action; Ensure must reuse it rather than manufacture a duplicate.
		return nil
	}
	return err
}

func (service Service) ApplyAction(ctx context.Context, studentID string, request domain.AssistantUIActionRequest) (result domain.AssistantUIActionResult, err error) {
	request, err = domain.NormalizeAssistantUIActionRequest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if service.Receipts == nil {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	stored, found, lookupErr := service.Receipts.Get(ctx, request.IdempotencyKey)
	if lookupErr != nil {
		return result, onboardingDependency(lookupErr)
	}
	if found {
		replayed, terminal, replayErr := domain.ReplayTerminalOnboardingAction(stored, request, studentID)
		if replayErr != nil || terminal {
			return replayed, replayErr
		}
		if stored.ExecutionMode == domain.OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy {
			return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
		}
	} else if !service.CanonicalActionsEnabled || !service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled || !service.ProductAwareEnabled || !service.PlannerHandoffEnabled {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if err = service.requireCanonicalActionRuntime(); err != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	teacher, binding, err := service.ensureBinding(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if binding.ID != request.DialogID {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	interaction, active, interactionErr := service.Interactions.GetActiveInteraction(ctx, binding.ID, request.MessageID, teacher.ID)
	if interactionErr != nil {
		return result, onboardingDependency(interactionErr)
	}
	if !active || interaction.PromptMessageVersion != int64(request.MessageVersion) {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	now := service.Clock.Now().UTC()
	lease := service.LeaseTTL
	if lease <= 0 {
		lease = 30 * time.Second
	}
	candidate, err := domain.NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(request, studentID, teacher.ID, service.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(lease), domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	receipt, _, err := service.Receipts.Claim(ctx, candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return result, receiptError(err)
	}
	if receipt.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptCompleted {
		replayed, _, replayErr := domain.ReplayTerminalOnboardingAction(receipt, request, studentID)
		return replayed, replayErr
	}
	if receipt.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized {
		return receipt.CanonicalResult(true)
	}
	if receipt.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptRejected {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	if receipt.ExecutionMode != domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if interaction.SessionSchemaVersion < 1 || interaction.SessionSchemaVersion > 3 {
		_ = service.Receipts.Reject(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), receipt.IdempotencyKey, receipt.ClaimToken, service.Clock.Now())
		return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	defer func() {
		if err != nil && isDependency(err) {
			_ = service.Receipts.Release(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), receipt.IdempotencyKey, receipt.ClaimToken, service.Clock.Now())
		}
	}()

	if receipt.Status == domain.OnboardingReceiptClaimed {
		canonicalResult, canonicalErr := service.materializeCanonical(ctx, binding, request, receipt)
		if canonicalErr != nil && !isDependency(canonicalErr) {
			_ = service.Receipts.Reject(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), receipt.IdempotencyKey, receipt.ClaimToken, service.Clock.Now())
		}
		return canonicalResult, canonicalErr
	}
	return result, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}

func (service Service) requireCanonicalActionRuntime() error {
	if service.Teachers == nil || service.Dialogs == nil ||
		service.Sources == nil || service.CanonicalMessages == nil || service.Receipts == nil || service.Interactions == nil ||
		service.IDs == nil || service.Clock == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	return nil
}

func (service Service) requireCanonicalEnsureAdmission() error {
	if !service.fullCutoverAdmissionEnabled() {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if err := service.requireCanonicalActionRuntime(); err != nil || service.StructuredMessages == nil || service.Students == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if !service.ProductAwareEnabled || !service.PlannerHandoffEnabled || service.Readiness == nil || service.PlainMessages == nil || service.Handoffs == nil || service.TerminalSessions == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	if service.PathOutcomeEnabled && service.PathOutcomes == nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	return nil
}

func (service Service) fullCutoverAdmissionEnabled() bool {
	return service.CanonicalActionsEnabled && service.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled && service.ProductAwareEnabled && service.PlannerHandoffEnabled
}

func onboardingPhaseForSlot(slot domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotCode) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Phase, error) {
	switch slot {
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotGoalCode:
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseGettingAcquainted, nil
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotLanguage:
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseDeterminingStart, nil
	case domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPhasePreparingPath, nil
	default:
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
}

func (service Service) materializeCanonical(ctx context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, request domain.AssistantUIActionRequest, receipt domain.OnboardingActionReceipt) (domain.AssistantUIActionResult, error) {
	if service.CanonicalMessages == nil {
		return domain.AssistantUIActionResult{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	source, err := service.Sources.GetAssistantUISource(ctx, binding, receipt.SourceMessageID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssistantUIActionResult{}, onboardingDependencyOrConflict(err)
	}
	command, err := domain.ResolveCanonicalOnboardingAction(source, binding, request, receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssistantUIActionResult{}, err
	}
	message, err := service.CanonicalMessages.MaterializeCanonicalStudentTurn(ctx, command)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssistantUIActionResult{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	message, err = domain.NewDialogCanonicalStudentTurn(binding, message, command)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssistantUIActionResult{}, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	completed, err := service.Receipts.CompleteCanonical(ctx, receipt.IdempotencyKey, receipt.ClaimToken, message.ID, service.Clock.Now())
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssistantUIActionResult{}, receiptError(err)
	}
	return completed.CanonicalResult(false)
}

func (service Service) loadSession(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, domain.TeacherDialogBinding, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	teacher, binding, err := service.ensureBinding(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return teacher, binding, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, err
	}
	if service.Students == nil || service.StructuredMessages == nil || service.Receipts == nil || service.Sources == nil {
		return teacher, binding, domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	state, err := service.Students.GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return teacher, binding, state, onboardingDependencyOrConflict(err)
	}
	return teacher, binding, state, nil
}

func (service Service) ensureBinding(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	if service.Teachers == nil || service.Dialogs == nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	teacher, err := service.Teachers.Execute(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, domain.TeacherDialogBinding{}, err
	}
	binding, err := service.Dialogs.EnsureTeacherDialog(ctx, studentID, teacher.ID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "")
	if err != nil {
		return teacher, binding, onboardingDependency(err)
	}
	if binding.StudentID != studentID || binding.PersonalTeacherID != teacher.ID || binding.ContextType != domain.LearningContextGeneral || binding.ContextID != "" {
		return teacher, binding, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable
	}
	return teacher, binding, nil
}

func onboardingDependency(err error) error {
	return errors.Join(domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable, err)
}
func historicalEvidenceUnavailable(err error) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict)
}
func onboardingDependencyOrConflict(err error) error {
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogRequestNotFound) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext) {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	return onboardingDependency(err)
}
func isDependency(err error) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable)
}
func receiptError(err error) error {
	if err == nil || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding) {
		return err
	}
	return onboardingDependency(err)
}
